services.name: Free intro session
services.description: A no-pressure conversation about your goals plus a movement assessment. No gym experience required.

services.name: 1:1 personal coaching
services.description: One-on-one strength and conditioning built around your schedule and your goals.

services.name: Small group training
services.description: Train alongside 3-5 others with the coaching attention of a private session.

services.name: 12-week transformation program
services.description: Structured strength, conditioning, and nutrition coaching aimed at a measurable goal.

services.name: Online coaching
services.description: Custom programming, form checks, and weekly check-ins for clients who can't train in person.

services.name: Sport performance prep
services.description: Speed, power, and agility training for athletes preparing for a season or tryout.
